title: POST /api/integration/kids-check
description: Integration token only. The integration asks before executing a kids action whose entity has a rate limit (rule snapshot kids.entities.<id>.rate_limit) and no parental release is running. The hub checks pause and counter like for its own control path and, when allowed, records the action (it counts as executed). grant: the opaque value the hub passed itself in <ns>.control when it controls for a child device; the hub then answers allowed without counting twice. Timeout of the integration 3 s; no answer = kids_hub_unreachable (the action is not executed). Never contains data values beyond the action (no codes).
